claim_or_scope: Whole of W: the complete frozen official source (title, preamble, 180 recitals, 113 articles, 13 annexes and final formal text; 1553 units) was inventoried and screened in source order; operative articles, annexes and formal provisions were read in full unit by unit; recitals REC1 to REC33 were read in full and REC34 to REC180 were screened from their opening text and length
search_description: Every unit was read (recitals partly, see deviation log) and coded by the executor; no keyword or pattern rule produced any analytical record; external instruments referred to in W (59 external reference records) were not retrieved and not searched

claim_or_scope: Search procedure for absence-dependent claims: the absence statements below concern the declared corpus W only and rest on the executor reading of every operative provision and annex and on the coded relations and assignments
search_description: Provisions conferring competences, powers or relations on the relevant positions were located by reading, not by pattern matching; statements are about the search, not about the law; silence is neither permission nor prohibition

claim_or_scope: No provision of W confers on a national authority a supervisory or enforcement competence over the Chapter V obligations of providers of general-purpose AI models, other than cooperation recipients (Article 53(3)), the request to the Commission (Article 88(2)) and the cooperation of market surveillance authorities with the AI Office for general-purpose AI systems (Article 75(2)-(3))
search_description: Reading of Chapter V, Chapter IX Sections 3 and 5 and the penalty provisions for a national competence over general-purpose AI model obligations; Article 75(1) gives the AI Office the powers of a market surveillance authority by reference to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 (external, not retrieved)

claim_or_scope: Involvement of a notified body is not a necessary stage of the conformity assessment of Annex III high-risk AI systems: internal control (Annex VI) is the stated route for points 2 to 8 (Article 43(2)) and one of two routes for point 1 where standards or common specifications were applied (Article 43(1))
search_description: Reading of Article 43 and Annexes VI and VII for the routes; the Annex VII route is mandatory only in the circumstances of Article 43(1) second subparagraph and for the Annex I products by reference to the sectoral acts

claim_or_scope: Involvement of a notified body is not a necessary stage of the conformity assessment of high-risk AI systems covered by Annex I Section A legislation
search_description: Article 43(3) refers the procedure to the relevant sectoral acts; whether third-party assessment is required is determined by those acts and by Article 6(1), which rest on the legislation listed in Annex I

claim_or_scope: No provision of W confers on any authority a general power to instruct national market surveillance authorities, other than the Commission decisions on national measures under Articles 46(5) and 81 and the Commission powers in Article 75 for AI systems based on general-purpose AI models
search_description: Reading of Chapter IX Section 3 and Article 74 for powers of direction over market surveillance authorities; the powers of market surveillance authorities themselves are those of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 (external, not retrieved)

claim_or_scope: Market surveillance of AI systems presenting a risk has no alternative path to the procedure of Articles 79 to 83 and the Union safeguard procedure
search_description: Article 74(4) excludes Articles 79 to 83 for AI systems related to Annex I Section A products where sectoral legislation provides equivalent procedures, which are external and not retrieved
